transport.endpoint: video-synthesis asynchronous POST then task GET

source.role: only first_frame image; no last_frame because identical endpoints previously over-constrained motion

method_hypothesis: First-frame-only lets Wan3 spend its temporal budget on continuous in-scene motion instead of interpolating identical first/last images. Adaptive ratio avoids the prior 1918px width mismatch. Concise motion-only language reduces static-scene restatement and avoids the old low-value breathing shortcut.

guardrails.get_retries: bounded transport retry only, never create a second task
guardrails.key_input: local secure prompt only; never persist
guardrails.postprocess: only after output audit; no crossfade or duplicate-frame seam repair

runner.endpoint_normalization: accept API Host, full video endpoint, or compatible-mode URL; retain only allowlisted Alibaba host and rebuild the video/task paths

preflight_observed.first_attempt: HTTP 404 after the user pasted the OpenAI-compatible /compatible-mode/v1 URL; no task id or result was created

next: After exact-SHA public validation of endpoint normalization, run one corrected first-frame-only task against the same allowlisted Alibaba API Host. The prior 404 is not a model call and must not be retried against the wrong path.
